stem: Two scouting teams report very different pest counts from the same room on the same day. What is the strongest quality-control response?
choices: Use the lower count so the room remains below threshold
Average the counts without examining how they were collected
Use the higher count automatically because it is safer
Compare sampling locations, search effort, identification criteria, and recording methods, then standardize the scouting protocol and repeat representative checks
rationale: Large observer differences can result from inconsistent sampling or identification. Standardized methods and repeat representative checks improve data quality before management decisions are based on the counts.
